content.text: In a standard composting toilet without urine diversion, urine and faeces mix. Urine is 95 percent water; the combined waste is too wet for aerobic composting, compacts. And produces strong ammonia odour. A urine diverting toilet routes the urine away. Leaving the solid waste to compost in a drier, better-aerated environment.

The bowl has two zones separated by a ridge. The front zone drains via a tube to a collection container or to a soakaway/drain. The rear zone drops into the composting chamber. Men must sit to urinate to direct the stream to the front zone. Women's anatomy directs urine naturally to the front zone when sitting. The front zone drain must slope at least 30 degrees and be 20 mm internal diameter to prevent blockage with urine scale build-up.

Fresh urine is effectively sterile. It develops ammonia odour within 24 to 48 hours as bacteria convert urea to ammonia. For garden use, urine can be stored in a sealed 25-litre container and used within 1 week. Or diluted immediately and applied. For long-term storage, adding a small amount of lactic acid prevents ammonia development. A household of four produces around 6 to 8 litres of urine per day.

Fresh urine as fertiliser guidelines: dilute 1:10 to 1:15 with water before applying. Apply to the soil around plant roots, not to leaves or edible parts. Do not apply within 1 month of harvest of root vegetables or leafy crops that contact the soil. Urine from a person taking prescription medications should not be used on food crops. Some drug metabolites are pharmacologically active and plant-available. The WHO rates undiluted, freshly collected urine as low-risk for helminth transmission.
Legal position in England and Wales

A composting toilet at a UK home needs an Environmental Permit if any effluent enters the ground. Most urine-diverting systems that drain to a soakaway need a bespoke permit rather than a standard exemption. Planning permission is also needed, with some exceptions for farm or off-grid buildings. Check with your local planning authority and the Environment Agency before installing.

attrs.symptom: Urine diverter drain blocked with white scale

content.text: Struvite crystallises in urine drains in hard-water areas. Dissolve with a dilute citric acid or vinegar solution left in the drain for 30 minutes, then flush. A monthly vinegar flush prevents scale build-up. Increasing the drain slope angle to 45 degrees reduces struvite deposition.
